label: De ente extrinsic-source controls
description: Closed controls for the De ente extrinsic-source route. Each open input fails in one interpretation and the conclusion fails there: the literal disjunction together with the weak exhaustiveness and some-cause (brute esse), the efficiency bridge with the weak exhaustiveness and some-cause downstream of it (formal nature, a label for an unconstrained non-efficient nature source), no-self-causation (self-cause), the self-causation reading with some-cause downstream (unrealized quiddity) and the actuality of causes of being (nonactual cause); one interpretation satisfies every input and the conclusion. These witness logical underdetermination under the encoded predicates only; they are not evidence that brute or formally sourced esse is possible or plausible.
